entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Ishaq al-Sahili, also known as al-Tuwayjin, was an Andalusi poet and fiqh scholar who became a favored member of the court of Mansa Musa, Emperor of Mali. He is the most renowned of the scholars from the wider Muslim world who emigrated to Mali in the aftermath of Mansa Musa's pilgrimage.
